name: augnes-operator
description: Augnes workflow harness plus a fail-closed local connection to the live supervised Augnes Companion for exact repository continuity.

interface.shortDescription: Use Augnes workflow skills inside Codex.
interface.longDescription: Packages Augnes workflow skills and one read-only local MCP connection that discovers the existing supervised Companion, resolves the current physical repository to one registered project, and returns exact canonical continuity without mock or fallback state.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use augnes_resume_repository automatically when the user asks to resume, continue, or inspect the current local repository with Augnes. Keep all work bounded, read-only until separately authorized, evidence-aware, and aligned with Augnes authority boundaries.
